empty.title: Your Library Is Empty
empty.description: Albums on your server will appear here once it has scanned them.

search.description: Find albums, songs and artists in your library.

downloads.description: Albums, playlists and songs you download play without a connection.

playlist.addedSkipped: Added to “{{name}}”. Skipped songs already in it.

estimateContentLength.label: Estimate Stream Size
estimateContentLength.info: Ask the server to estimate stream size to help playback and seeking. Turn off if your server reports a zero duration or playback fails. Applies to new playback and download requests.

autoOpenNowPlaying.label: Open Now Playing Automatically
autoOpenNowPlaying.info: Shows Now Playing when you start playing an album, playlist or song.

downloadConcurrency.label: Track Download Concurrency
downloadConcurrency.info: Number of tracks downloaded at once. Increasing the limit starts waiting tracks immediately; decreasing it lets current downloads finish.

different.title: Switch Accounts?
different.message: Signing in as {{user}} on {{server}} erases the library, downloads and play history of {{previousUser}} on {{previousServer}} from this device. Nothing is removed from the server.

server.title: Is This the Same Server?
server.message: This device holds the library, downloads and play history of {{user}} on {{previousServer}}. Keep them if {{server}} is the same server at a new address, or erase them and start fresh.

unknown.title: Keep the Existing Library?
unknown.message: This device holds a library and downloads from an earlier sign-in. Keep them if they belong to {{user}} on {{server}}, or erase them and start fresh.

tailscale.subnetRoutesDescription: Connect to server IPs through subnet routes approved in your tailnet. Routes refresh automatically. This does not enable an exit node.
tailscale.description: Connect directly to your private music server without enabling the system Tailscale VPN. Your music server still requires its own sign-in.
tailscale.hostsDescription: Tailnet IPs, .ts.net addresses and discovered device names connect automatically. Accepted subnet routes also match server IPs automatically. Add custom hostnames here, separated by commas.
tailscale.authKeyDescription: Use a key from your own tailnet. One-time keys are recommended. Only the resulting device identity is saved.
tailscale.forgetDescription: Local node keys will be removed and you will need to sign in again. This does not delete the device from the Tailscale admin console.
tailscale.error: Could not connect to Tailscale. Check your connection or sign in again.
tailscale.downloadsDescription: Tailscale downloads require Aonsoku to keep running. If iOS suspends the app, reopen it to continue downloading.
